# Generated Files Index

## STM32N6 CPU/Cortex-M Generated Project

Path:

```text
generated_project/
```

Generated by:

```powershell
stedgeai generate --target stm32n6 -m .\models\best.onnx -t onnx -w .\stedgeai_output\workspace_generate_cpu -o .\generated_project --verbosity 1
```

Files:

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `network.c` | Generated network implementation |
| `network.h` | Public network API definitions |
| `network_data.c` | Weights and constant data |
| `network_data.h` | Data declarations |
| `network_details.h` | Generated tensor, layer, and metadata details |
| `network_c_info.json` | ST Edge AI model metadata |
| `network_generate_report.txt` | Full generation report and memory summary |
| `LICENSE.txt` | ST generated license file |

## Important Limits

- This generated project is the STM32N6 CPU/Cortex-M path, not a confirmed Neural-ART NPU project.
- Neural-ART generation was not executed after NPU analyze failed.
- The NPU pass should be rerun from an ASCII-only path and preferably with an INT8 model.
